schemaVersion.description: MCP I/O schema version of this input. Optional; when present it must be 1.

recording.description: A RecordedTx exactly as the record tool returns it in `recording` (or as `npm run record` prints): bigints as decimal strings, bytes as hex:… strings.

recordingPath.description: Path to a saved recording (e.g. examples/live/recorded-claim-swap-fresh.json). Alternative to recording.

capMultiplier.description: Cap = observed gross outflow × this, rounded up (default 1.1).

constrainArguments.description: Enforce the derived argument constraints (swap-path token set): a violating route is DENIED. Default false: permitted and FLAGGED as a scope gap.

config.description: Synthesis configuration overrides; omitted fields keep their defaults.

address.description: A Stellar account (G…) or contract (C…) address.

keyData.description: Raw public-key bytes, hex (32 bytes for ed25519).

items.description: A context-rule signer in the OpenZeppelin Signer shape.

signers.description: Signers attached to every emitted rule (≤ 15).

policyAddresses.description: Deployed policy contract address per binding kind.

ledgerHead.description: Live ledger head at synthesis time; when given, validUntilLedger is emitted absolute (head + lifetime). Omit to emit the relative lifetimeLedgers only.

installTargets.description: Deploy-time facts (signers, deployed policy addresses, ledger head). Without them the artifact is a design document and installable.asIs is false.

now.description: Unix seconds used as the base of the rule lifetime. Defaults to the recording timestamp (the CLI’s rule), keeping the output deterministic.

outDir.description: If given, also write summary.txt, spec.json, context-rule.json and FrequencyLimitPolicy.rs into this directory (created if missing). Existing files are not replaced unless overwrite is true.

overwrite.description: Allow outDir writes to replace existing files (default false: an existing file is a BAD_INPUT and nothing is written).

includeRustSource.description: Include the full generated Rust source inline in rustPolicy.source (about 11 KB). Default: true when outDir is not given; false when the file was written to outDir (rustPolicy.path names it). The banner, fileName and sourceBytes are always present.
